tasks.title: Design Database Service Interface
tasks.description: Define the service interface for reading database files in TO.Services.Core
tasks.details: Create an interface with methods for loading and querying database files such as AttributeDatabase.db and GameplayEffectDatabase.db. Define method signatures for data retrieval and error handling.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests to verify interface compliance and method signature correctness.

tasks.title: Implement Database Reader Service
tasks.description: Implement the database reader service in TO.Services.Core
tasks.details: Develop the implementation of the database service using SQLite or an appropriate database access library. Implement methods to load and query database files.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests to verify database connection, file loading, and query execution.

tasks.title: Design Data Model Conversion Classes
tasks.description: Define the structure of conversion classes for TO.Data.Models.GameAbilitySystem
tasks.details: Create classes to convert raw database data into model classes like AttributeSet and AttributeValue. Define properties and methods for type conversion and data validation.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests to verify class structure and property definitions.

tasks.title: Implement Attribute Data Conversion
tasks.description: Convert AttributeDatabase.db data to AttributeSet and AttributeValue models
tasks.details: Implement logic to parse AttributeDatabase.db and convert its data into AttributeSet and AttributeValue model classes. Handle type conversion and data validation.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests to validate data conversion accuracy and error handling.

tasks.title: Implement Gameplay Effect Data Conversion
tasks.description: Convert GameplayEffectDatabase.db data to corresponding model classes
tasks.details: Develop logic to parse GameplayEffectDatabase.db and map its data to model classes. Implement handling for effect definitions, conditions, and modifiers.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests to ensure correct parsing and mapping of gameplay effect data.

tasks.title: Integrate Database Service with Conversion Classes
tasks.description: Link database reader service with data model conversion classes
tasks.details: Modify the database service to pass raw data to conversion classes. Ensure seamless data flow from database reading to model conversion.
tasks.testStrategy: Integration tests to verify data flow and conversion accuracy.

tasks.title: Implement Data Validation Logic
tasks.description: Add data validation during conversion process
tasks.details: Develop validation rules to ensure data integrity during conversion. Validate data types, required fields, and value ranges.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests to check validation logic and error reporting.

tasks.title: Create Unit Tests for Database Service
tasks.description: Write unit tests for database reader service
tasks.details: Develop unit tests to cover database connection, file loading, and query execution. Use mocking to simulate database interactions.
tasks.testStrategy: Test coverage for all service methods with mock database responses.

tasks.title: Create Unit Tests for Conversion Classes
tasks.description: Write unit tests for data model conversion classes
tasks.details: Develop unit tests to validate data conversion logic, type mapping, and validation rules. Use test data from the database files.
tasks.testStrategy: Test coverage for all conversion methods with sample data.

tasks.title: Perform Integration Testing
tasks.description: Test end-to-end data flow from database to models
tasks.details: Run integration tests to verify the complete workflow: database reading, data conversion, and model output. Validate data integrity and performance.
tasks.testStrategy: End-to-end tests covering all data flow stages with real database files.
